curationNotes: Startup Gmail signature preflight passed. Curated from live indexed Wix small-business sites in the 2026-05-14 2:00 AM run. Inspected 10 candidate sites total, selected all 10 because each has live contact info, local-service intent, source assets, and visible conversion cleanup needs. Duplicates from previous batches were excluded before selection. Prototypes must be GPT-5.5-authored one site per isolated sub-agent, no old scripted generator.

items.name: Rags 2 Riches Cleaning Services LLC
items.summary: Wix cleaning site has a real founder story, broad service list, booking/contact nav, and service images, but the first screen is generic and the quote path is buried below boilerplate.
items.angle: Keep the purple/cleaning-service Wix feel and real service imagery while tightening the hero, service grouping, trust cues, and a faster request-a-cleaning path.

items.name: Blissfully Clean LLC
items.vertical: residential, commercial, vacation-rental, and construction cleaning
items.summary: The site includes strong natural-products positioning, pricing, services, and contact details, but the homepage is sparse and does not surface proof or booking next steps quickly enough.
items.angle: Preserve the simple friendly cleaning look while making natural products, licensed/insured proof, pricing, and contact CTA easier to scan.

items.name: Pino Handyman LLC
items.summary: Owner-led handyman page has real experience, logo, phone, and email, but it opens on an About page and misses a clear service/estimate funnel above the fold.
items.angle: Keep the compact logo/photo contractor layout while turning the first screen into a handyman estimate page with service categories, trust, and phone/email CTAs.

items.name: Plumb-It Co. Plumbing LLC
items.summary: The plumbing site has a strong service list, email, phone, and logo, but it is mostly a text list and lacks emergency/quote prioritization or proof cues.
items.angle: Preserve the straightforward plumbing layout and logo while organizing services into urgent, repair, and install paths with a prominent call button.

items.name: APM Cleaning Services LLC
items.vertical: residential cleaning, concierge, organizing, and changeover services
items.summary: APM has authentic service copy, phone/email, and images, but the page still advertises an expired 2015 coupon and the conversion path feels dated.
items.angle: Keep the teal/orange local-cleaning character while replacing expired promo clutter with current quote framing, service packages, and trust cues.

items.name: Celestial Cleaning LLC
items.summary: Commercial cleaning site has a real address, family-owned positioning, certification language, and contact form, but the hero repeats generic claims and includes leftover donation/navigation clutter.
items.angle: Keep the blue celestial/minnesota feel while focusing the page on workplace cleaning, disinfecting proof, service area, and a quote/contact flow.

items.name: Krebs Lawn Care LLC
items.vertical: lawn mowing, mulch, hedge trimming, and brush hauling
items.summary: Small lawn-care site has owner/local info, phone, email, logo, and lawn imagery, but it is extremely thin and needs clearer service/value framing.
items.angle: Preserve the small-town lawn-care aesthetic while adding a concise services grid, service-area confidence, seasonal estimate CTA, and simple next steps.

items.name: JBI Plumbing LLC
items.summary: JBI has strong emergency availability, master plumber license info, phone/email, and many services, but the homepage is cluttered and repetitive.
items.angle: Keep the bold plumbing contractor feel while tightening emergency call flow, license proof, service cards, and renovation/repair pathways.

items.name: Mr. Bill Handyman LLC
items.vertical: handyman, home improvement, renovation, and repair
items.summary: The site has personality, licensing/insurance details, local service areas, family story, and many source images, but the conversion path is buried in dense copy.
items.angle: Keep the personable handyman brand and project imagery while bringing license proof, service categories, and email/phone estimate CTA into a cleaner flow.

items.name: ACP Cleaning Services LLC
items.vertical: residential, commercial, school, daycare, carpet, and floor cleaning
items.summary: ACP has a real service-area strip, phone, service pages, quote CTA, and multiple photos, but the homepage is crowded and the copy needs sharper hierarchy.
items.angle: Preserve the blue/green cleaning brand and original photos while clarifying top services, quote CTA, service areas, and reliability proof.
